source: ESPN public scoreboard and injuries feeds

Brooklyn Nets.detail: Wagner (knee) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Charlotte Hornets.detail: Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.
Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.
Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

Chicago Bulls.detail: Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.
Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Cleveland Cavaliers.detail: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

Golden State Warriors.detail: Curry (abdomen) will be re-evaluated Friday after Thanksgiving, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

LA Clippers.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Memphis Grizzlies.detail: Edey (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers. He finished with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes.
Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Minnesota Timberwolves.detail: Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

New York Knicks.detail: Drummond (head) did not return to Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.
Anunoby (calf) participated in on-court work for the first time since sustaining the injury, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.
McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.
Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

Oklahoma City Thunder.detail: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.
Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.
Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.
Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.
Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Philadelphia 76ers.detail: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
Brown (hamstring) will receive imaging, and the Sixers will provide an update Thursday, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Phoenix Suns.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Portland Trail Blazers.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Sacramento Kings.detail: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.
Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

San Antonio Spurs.detail: Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
